_: WS-E1 measurement dossier for Eighth College, built 2026-08-06. Every entry keyed by mass hash m:<cx>,<cz> = Math.round(vertex-average centroid) of the docs/data/campus-arcgis.json massing ring at build-campus-truecolor.mjs's keyOf() rule (rings /10) — verified against the actual massing polygons, which in one case (Sankofa Base) round 1m differently than the hand-given task centroid, so these keys are the polygon-derived ones, not the hand-rounded ones. Colours sampled with scripts/tmp-sample.mjs (median of a masked pixel patch) from Apple Maps 3D captures ONLY (.cache/apple-flyover, .cache/eighth-area) per the epoch rule — never from .cache/tiles-orbit, which is Google mid-construction imagery used only to cross-check facade geometry. Storey counts are GIS docs/data/campus-arcgis.json massing.levels, visually corroborated by counting window rows in a lit frame; bay_m is a VISUAL-ESTIMATE class measurement (piers counted in a near-corner, least-foreshortened crop, scaled by a floor-height calibration derived from the same crop) — treat it as a candidate figure, not survey-grade. Buildings with no captured station within useful range (Survivance tower+low sit toward the uncaptured r3 row) or with a facade never legibly resolved (Podemos low, unnamed dining pavilion, most of Sankofa Base) are OMITTED or marked resolved:false rather than guessed — see the builder report for the full per-mass account. WS-E2 (2026-08-06) added the ground key: 74 ground-plane features for Eighth (1 basketball court, 19 walkway/paving-zone, 7 courtyard, 47 planting-bed), all snapped to already-surveyed docs/data/campus-arcgis.json ground[] polygons (registration arcgis.ground#<index>, ring coords /10 to get metres) rather than hand-measured off Apple pixels, per the tasks own STRONGLY PREFERRED guidance. The basketball court is additionally photo-confirmed (r1c2-plan-00-south.png, blue surface + white key markings) and its surface colour sampled from that frame. courtyard/planting-bed kind is a >200sqm size heuristic (shoelace-formula polygon area, corrected 2026-08-06 cycle-2 from an earlier bounding-box-area computation that had misclassified 10 sub-200sqm polygons as courtyard) over GIS green polygons (GIS does not itself distinguish lawn/courtyard from planting bed) — not individually photo-confirmed per polygon. arcgis.ground#409 (a 9.7sqm sliver on a 21m-long, <0.5m-wide diagonal strip) was dropped rather than mislabeled: its shape is not a real distinct planting/courtyard feature, almost certainly a walkway-edge fragment misrouted into the green layer. Stepped terraces and stair flights were investigated but OMITTED: docs/data/textures ground-texture chunks covering Eighth (chunk_3_8.jpg, chunk_4_8.jpg) are themselves mid-construction-epoch Google imagery (visible scaffolding/bare dirt), so texture-chunk registration is contaminated for this area exactly like .cache/tiles-orbit and cannot be used; a real stair+handrail was located in eighth-area/r2c1-plan-00-south.png near a western courtyard, but the flight descends into a photogrammetry mesh reconstruction gap (a jagged dark hole artifact) that makes per-step run/rise unmeasurable to the required confidence, so it was left out rather than guessed (frames tried: r1c2-plan-00-south.png — hard shadow at the Sankofa Base plinth; r1c1-plan-00-south.png — no stair geometry resolved, only a road kerb ramp; r2c1-plan-00-south.png — real stair found but occluded by a mesh gap beyond the top ~5 treads). One oversized arcgis green polygon cluster (#1127, 73.7x184.5m, and #1160, 63.6x46m) was excluded as too large/ambiguous to label a single courtyard-scale feature (likely hillside greenbelt) rather than mislabel it.

m:-68,594.name: Sankofa Tower
m:-68,594.note: bay_m derived from a floor-height calibration (64m/21 levels) applied to a near-corner pier count in sankofa-orbit-00-south.png — moderate confidence (±~25%), not a direct scale-bar measurement. Wall hex is a median of 4 panel samples ranging #a8a7ae–#efecf0 (mixed sun/shade); reported value is the mid sample.

m:-56,528.name: Podemos
m:-56,528.note: Identity confirmed by station proximity (Podemos centroid is 7.8m from the r1c3 capture target, next-nearest Eighth mass is 70m+ away). The dark reflective-glass face seen in r1c3-oblique-01-west is this same tower's short-end core, not a separate building.

m:-116,613.name: Sankofa Mid
m:-116,613.note: Wall samples in the top-down r2c2-plan-00-south.png frame were blown out by direct sun (l>0.95); walls value is from the same building's less-glared oblique frame instead.

m:-182,614.name: Azad
m:-182,614.note: Measured walls (#d8d3d3, light neutral grey-white) disagree with the unsourced first-guess #d2b895 (tan/khaki) — trust the measured value; Azad's centroid is only 13.7m from the r2c1 capture target, the closest station-to-mass match of any building in this dossier.

m:-154,556.name: Pulse Tower
m:-154,556.note: Pulse Tower and Pulse Mid are visually one continuous block in every available frame (both within ~40m of the r1c1 target, no station separates them) — this entry and m:-186,562 share the same measured walls/style/bay_m from the same facade. Levels (10 vs 9) come from GIS, not a visual per-mass split.

m:-186,562.name: Pulse Mid
m:-186,562.note: See Pulse Tower (m:-154,556) — same source facade, could not visually separate the two masses at this station; GIS levels kept distinct.

m:-97,609.name: Sankofa Base
m:-97,609.note: Only a dusty maroon canopy/soffit strip at the tower's ground-floor plinth was legible (measured #8c6d75, sampled twice, consistent) — recorded as an accent. The plinth's actual wall material (mostly glass storefront) sits in hard shadow in every captured frame at this station (r2c2, 20m away) and in r2c1/r2c3 (49-86m away); did not guess a walls value.

basketball-court.note: Union bounding rectangle of two adjacent arcgis.ground court polygons (#3898 south half + #3923 north half, both k:"court"); the 4 small #k:"court" rectangles at indices 3785/3806/3918/3921 (~1.8x3.6m each) are the painted free-throw keys visible as white lane markings inside this rectangle, not separate ground features. Plan footprint measures 22.7m x 15.4m — the 15.4m cross-dimension matches a regulation FIBA/NBA court width (15.24m) closely, but the 22.7m long dimension is ~79% of the 28.65m regulation full-court length, so this is NOT a regulation-sized full court (likely a shortened recreational/practice court) — reported as measured, not corrected to regulation. Surface colour #2c4460 is the median of 272 pixel samples of the mid-blue court apron band in r1c2-plan-00-south.png (the darker navy key/lane paint and white line-work were excluded from the sample).
